title: LIFU for Chronic Pain and Generalized Anxiety Disorder
official: Accelerated Low-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (LIFU) for Chronic Pain and Generalized Anxiety Disorder: A Proof-of-Concept Case Series
summary: A proof of concept case study to investigate accelerated LIFU protocol in chronic pain and anxiety populations.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* GAD Symptoms - GAD-7 score \>= 10, OASIS score \>= 8, or PSWQ score \>= 45. OR Chronic pain symptoms - moderate to severe pain, present for at least 3 months.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Claustrophobia
* Contraindications to MRI or CT
* Active medical disorder with CNS effects
* History of neurologic disorder
* History of head injury with LOC \> 10 minutes
* Active drug or alcohol dependence
sponsor: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

sites.f: Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at VTC
